task_name: Problem-Agnostic Adaptive-Remeshing Pipeline Qualification and Hidden-Assumption Audit
description: Perform problem-independent adaptive-remeshing pipeline qualification: (1) query fresh scheduler state (qstat -u pr21vyci); (2) audit active remeshing Python scripts for hidden benchmark-specific assumptions (y=0.5, x=0.5, hardcoded corridors/sets/bounds/masks) and refactor into explicit generic config schema; (3) establish reusable contract (FE stress field -> MISESERI -> RemeshingRule -> adaptiveRemesh -> new topology); (4) test generic pipeline on 3 spatially distinct patterns: Mode-I horizontal, Mode-II inclined, and third non-symmetric geometry (hole/notched-hole/L-panel); (5) measure quantitative fidelity metrics (% top 10% refined, % fine in high error, r(log M, h), spatial overlap, size bounds); (6) generate true element-edge figures; (7) isolate remaining Mode-II problem as upstream constitutive/BC defect; (8) protect Mode-I with regression tests; (9) zero Mode-II fracture solve submissions.
